deep_green_bg.use: Base background for all images, carousels, videos

teal_glow.use: Primary accent; 'Fast' in wordmark; gradient start; aurora glow

teal_bright_video.use: Teal used in video renders (same role as teal_glow)

gold.use: Highlight / CTA pills / gradient end / small glow accent. Use sparingly

mint.use: Body and secondary text on dark green

aurora_background: Deep green base #04302A with large blurred radial glows: teal top-left (~37% alpha), emerald bottom-right (~59% alpha), small gold glow top-right (~12% alpha). Mirror the positions per slide for variety.
wordmark: 'Paid' in white + 'Fast' in teal, Manrope Bold, no space between
logo: paidfast-logo-icon.png (1024x1024, transparent). Keep it large: >=10% of frame width on posts, >=14% on Stories/Reels openers and end cards
